aphids.description: Small sap-sucking insects that cause yellowing and curling of leaves.

army_worm.description: Caterpillars that feed on leaves and can defoliate entire plants.

bollworm.description: Larvae that bore into cotton bolls, causing significant yield loss.

stem_borer.description: Larvae that tunnel into stems, causing plants to wilt and die.

whitefly.description: Small white insects that suck sap and transmit viral diseases.

rust_fungus.description: Fungal disease causing orange-brown pustules on leaves and stems.

hessian_fly.description: Small flies whose larvae feed on wheat stems, stunting growth.

spider_mites.description: Tiny mites that suck plant juices, causing yellow stippling on leaves.

leaf_folder.description: Larvae that fold and feed inside rice leaves, reducing photosynthesis.

blast_fungus.description: Fungal disease causing lesions on leaves, nodes, and panicles.

brown_plant_hopper.description: Sap-sucking insects that cause hopper burn and transmit viruses.

corn_borer.description: Larvae that tunnel into corn stalks and ears, reducing yield.

earworm.description: Caterpillars that feed on corn ears, damaging kernels.

corn_leaf_aphid.description: Aphids that cluster on leaves and tassels, reducing plant vigor.

Maintain proper plant spacing for air circulation
cotton_prevention: Install yellow sticky traps for whiteflies
Apply recommended insecticides at first sight
rice_prevention: Maintain proper water level in fields
Apply recommended pesticides at tillering stage
corn_prevention: Plant early to avoid peak pest season
Monitor for egg masses on leaves

low_tip_1: Delay irrigation if rain is forecast

furrow_irrigation_desc: Traditional method for row crops, moderate efficiency
flood_irrigation_desc: Used for rice and some field crops, lower efficiency
basin_irrigation_desc: Suitable for orchards and some field crops
